blocks.text: Maple Ridge houses by price band, September 2026

40 houses sold in September against 410 listed. The price band with the most sales was $1,000,001 to $1,250,000, with 13 sold (32% of the month). Among bands with at least ten homes listed, the highest sales ratio was $800,001 to $900,000 at 35%.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Bands with nothing listed and nothing sold are left out. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Maple Ridge?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 410 houses listed in Maple Ridge and 40 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 10%. Month-end counts move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: What is the reported sale price for houses in Maple Ridge?
faq.a: The September report gave $1,131,000 for houses in Maple Ridge, against $1,195,000 the month before. The reports give one sale-price figure and do not say whether it is an average or a median, so use it for direction, not as a valuation of your own home.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Maple Ridge?
faq.a: The September report showed 29 days on market for houses in Maple Ridge and a sale-to-list price ratio of 97%, against 31 days the month before.

faq.q: Do I need a home inspection when buying in Maple Ridge?
faq.a: It is strongly recommended. Make the offer subject to an inspection so a qualified inspector can look at the roof, structure, drainage, electrical and heating before you remove conditions.

faq.q: Can I add a suite or coach house to a house in Maple Ridge?
faq.a: BC's small-scale multi-unit housing rules allow more homes on many urban lots, but each municipality sets the details and many lots are excluded. Check the lot's zoning with the municipality before you plan a suite or coach house.
